title: Anna and Her Dog
text:
Anna has a dog. The dog is small and brown. Every morning Anna walks with the dog in the park. They walk for twenty minutes.

After the walk, Anna goes home. She gives the dog water and food. Then she makes tea for herself. She likes to read a book in the afternoon.

questions.text: What does Anna give the dog after the walk?
Why does Anna walk with the dog every morning?
options: She likes the dog and wants to exercise with it
She has to find a new house
She is afraid of the park
She wants to buy a car

questions.text: What kind of person is Anna most likely to be?
options: A lazy person who never goes out
A person who does not like animals
A person who lives in the park

vocabulary.definition: a common animal that people keep as a pet
a public green area where people walk and relax
a clear liquid that people and animals drink
the part of the day between noon and evening

paragraph_translations: Anna ma psa. Pies jest mały i brązowy. Każdego ranka Anna chodzi z psem do parku. Spacerują przez dwadzieścia minut.
Po spacerze Anna wraca do domu. Daje psu wodę i jedzenie. Potem robi sobie herbatę. Lubi czytać książkę po południu.
